hubspot/companies.grain: One fictional client/prospect company as of cutoff

hubspot/deals.grain: One deal current state at cutoff
hubspot/deals.notes: Won deal amount is a quote/bookings measure, never earned revenue.

hubspot/deal_stage_history.grain: One observed sales-stage or expected-close revision; same-stage events revise forecast properties

hubspot/deal_monthly_snapshots.grain: One deal known at a historical month-end
hubspot/deal_monthly_snapshots.notes: Closed-won/lost rows carry zero weighted open pipeline.

contracts/monthly_terms.grain: One signed retainer service month including known future months

contracts/rate_cards.grain: One hourly bill rate per role/effective interval

contracts/fee_calculations.grain: One observed monthly retainer fee calculation
contracts/fee_calculations.notes: Media spend is a fee driver, not agency revenue.

contracts/billing_schedule.grain: One planned billing allocation to a service obligation
contracts/billing_schedule.notes: Historical billed rows and future known billings share the same schedule; do not add actual and schedule amounts.

timekeeping/projects.grain: One internal or contract delivery project

timekeeping/work_calendar.grain: One calendar date in historical window

timekeeping/daily_capacity.grain: One active employee weekday, including paid leave

timekeeping/timesheets.notes: Retainer and fixed-fee billable time does not generate extra hourly invoices.

gusto/employees.grain: One fictional employee across entire roster history

gusto/compensation_rates.grain: One effective salary interval; all tax parameters are synthetic

gusto/payroll_runs.grain: One semimonthly payroll, with one opening run

gusto/payroll_funding.notes: Provider remits tax/benefits from this debit; do not add another tax cash payment.

gusto/cost_allocations.notes: Secondary view of already-posted payroll, not an additional expense.

freelancers/work_orders.grain: One monthly approved freelance work authorization

freelancers/approved_work.grain: One accepted freelance work item/earned cost
freelancers/approved_work.notes: Expense arises here once; subsequent QB bill clears accrued contractor cost.

meta_ads/daily_metrics.notes: Platform attribution can overlap across platforms; values are not agency sales.

meta_ads/monthly_billing.grain: One analytical monthly client platform-spend statement
meta_ads/monthly_billing.notes: Monthly consolidation is a synthetic simplification; client bank settlement is not observed.

google_ads/daily_metrics.notes: Platform attribution can overlap across platforms; values are not agency sales.

google_ads/monthly_billing.grain: One analytical monthly client platform-spend statement
google_ads/monthly_billing.notes: Monthly consolidation is a synthetic simplification; client bank settlement is not observed.

delivery/service_obligations.grain: One priced monthly service or approved milestone; includes signed future obligations

delivery/recognition_events.grain: One actual earning or fee-concession event

quickbooks/opening_trial_balance.grain: One opening account balance; excluded from period activity

quickbooks/client_invoices.grain: One client fee invoice, including opening receivables

quickbooks/client_invoice_lines.grain: One fee invoice allocation to a service

quickbooks/receipt_applications.grain: One client receipt application to an invoice

quickbooks/vendors.grain: One fictional vendor or named-system modeled supplier

quickbooks/vendor_bill_lines.grain: One AP line; freelance lines debit accrued liability

quickbooks/ar_open_items.grain: One unpaid client invoice at cutoff

quickbooks/ap_open_items.grain: One unpaid vendor bill at cutoff

quickbooks/general_ledger.notes: Opening TB is separate. No year-end closing journals in this 24-month extract.

quickbooks/monthly_trial_balance.grain: One account/month; signs debit minus credit

bank/accounts.grain: One fictional agency operating bank account

bank/transactions.grain: One actual agency bank statement movement

planning/budget_versions.grain: One immutable original annual management budget

planning/monthly_budget.grain: One original monthly budget line; revenue and expense amounts positive

planning/signed_future_commitments.grain: One already-signed future billing item at cutoff
planning/signed_future_commitments.notes: Convenience copy of future billing schedule, not another fact.

planning/collection_expectations.grain: One management collection assumption for existing AR
planning/collection_expectations.notes: Expected date is not an actual receipt.

planning/recurring_obligations.grain: One active operating vendor obligation at cutoff

planning/payroll_commitments.grain: One earned but unfunded payroll run at cutoff

planning/contractor_accruals.grain: One accepted but not yet invoiced freelance work item

finance/debt_register.grain: One term loan; rate is an invented contract parameter

finance/debt_schedule.grain: One future contractual debt payment, not an actual

finance/owner_distributions.grain: One actual owner distribution; financing only

finance/prepaid_amortization.grain: One monthly release of paid insurance asset
